svg.title: The beat - one 10 ms Botanik scan cycle
svg.text: one beat = TASK_PERIOD_MS = 10 ms - the phases run in this order every beat, whatever happens to be due
one image, one instant - every program this beat reads the same field
OUTPUT sits outside the control gate on purpose: withdrawing control writes safe states into the image, and
something still has to carry them to the field.
